project_meta.title: Orthopedic Arthroplasty & Diabetic Incision Surrogate Computational Biology Framework
project_meta.theme: 骨科 + 糖尿病 + 伤口/护理 (Orthopedics + Diabetes + Wound Care / Bedside Nursing)
project_meta.provenance: Every entry below was re-verified by reading the GEO series_matrix header and suppl/filelist.txt directly. v1.1.0 asserted eight datasets; three were wrong organism/tissue/design and were removed. GSE241132 was added after its use in T2/T3 was found. GSE223964 and GSE245703 are now on the mainline as external frozen-projection cohorts: both have DFU tissue and disease/genotype metadata, neither has a healing endpoint. See docs/05_DATASET_AUDIT.md.
project_meta.surrogate_rationale: Direct human TJA surgical incision biopsy is restricted by clinical ethics (PJI risk). The claim this framework can defend is narrow: not anatomical equivalence between foot skin and joint tissue, but a shared sterile myeloid activation programme. Anything beyond that is unsupported by these data.

GSE165816.verified: series_matrix + filelist read 2026-09-17; author clinical table and series-level provenance joined 2026-09-20
GSE165816.title: Single Cell Transcriptomic Landscape of Diabetic Foot Ulcers
GSE165816.design: 10 non-diabetic subjects, 17 diabetic (11 with DFU, 6 without); foot skin, forearm skin and PBMCs
GSE165816.file_format: RAW.tar of 54 *dense* CSV.gz (genes x barcodes), NOT 10x mtx triplets
GSE165816.outcome_variable: disease: DFU-healer | DFU-nonhealer | Non-DFU Diabetic | Non-diabetic
caveats: Raw sequence data withheld for patient privacy; only processed counts are public.
The 94k cell figure spans foot skin + forearm skin + PBMC. The DFU foot-skin subset is substantially smaller; do not quote 94k as the DFU sample size.
Dense CSV loading is ~452 MB/sample; use core_engines.data_adapter (CSR int32) or the cohort will not fit in RAM.
No cell-type annotation ships with the archive; annotation must be derived and is a human-in-the-loop step.

GEO still has no patient field. The Nature Communications 13:181 clinical table maps all 54 GSM titles onto 27 subjects. The 14 DFU foot samples are 11 patients (7 healer / 4 non-healer); G4+G23, G7+G8 and G33+G34 are same-wound same-day replicates. That map lives under metadata_intake/ and does not admit the discovery set as experiment A.

Finest public laboratory process is series-level: identical Chromium 3' V2/V3 extract protocol and Illumina NovaSeq 6000 / NovaSeq S4 instrument text for all 54 samples. Raw reads withheld; no SRR or per-sample chemistry assignment.
GSE165816.mapping_role: Core discovery set and the project's ONLY real clinical outcome variable. Author subject map and GEO-declared series-level batch/run are now local; the collapsed 11-patient prognostic contract is accepted. This is still not experiment A.

GSE231643.module: Module 1b (directional frozen projection): human DFU debridement single-cell
GSE231643.title: Diabetic foot ulcers debridement SCRNA-seq showed healing association with inflammatory fibroblasts in minorities
GSE231643.design: Debrided DFU from healing and non-healing patients, African American and White
GSE231643.local_status: Downloaded and byte-count verified at data/raw/GSE231643/GSE231643_RAW.tar. Loaded: 35,655 cells x 36,591 gene symbols, 30,484 after QC.
GSE231643.labels_recovered: Healing status is NOT a characteristics key. Recovered from !Sample_title: H1-H5 = healer (5), NH1/NH2/NH4 = non-healer (3).
caveats: n=5 vs 3. The smallest attainable two-sided Mann-Whitney p is 0.0357, and a 15-topic Bonferroni threshold is 0.0033, so NO result from this cohort can survive multiple-testing correction. It can corroborate a direction, never confirm one.
Cells are not replicates. With 30,484 cells from 8 patients, cell-level p-values are pseudoreplication and must not be reported.
Debridement tissue, whereas GSE165816 is surgically resected. Epithelial content is not comparable between the two, which confounds any keratinocyte-topic contrast.
GSE231643.mapping_role: Directional external projection for HE-Fibro / macrophage-polarisation claims; healing labels are title-derived and the cohort does not pass the authoritative patient prognostic contract.

GSE326622.module: Module 2 (temporal anchor): murine wound healing time course
GSE326622.title: Mechanotransduction unifies healthy non-diabetic wound healing over time by promoting a Cd14+/C1qa+ fibroblast subpopulation
GSE326622.design: Full-thickness EXCISIONAL dorsal wounds; N-DB (WT), P-DB (high-fat-diet), G-DB (leptin-receptor-deficient) x POD0 / POD2 / POD7 / POD30
GSE326622.local_status: Downloaded to data/raw/GSE326622/per_gsm/ as 36 loose per-GSM files (1.1 GB), all 36 byte-count verified against filelist.txt. Load with core_engines.data_adapter.load_10x_mtx_dir. Verified readable: 2-sample smoke load gave 30,134 cells x 32,255 mouse gene symbols.
GSE326622.download_route: PER-GSM ONLY. The series-level GSE326622_RAW.tar is NOT retrievable: two independent attempts both truncated at ~780 MB of 1,132,769,280 (780,318,127 and 781,318,127 bytes, 'transfer closed with ~352 MB remaining'). Reproducible server-side failure; retrying the tar is futile. Use scripts/fetch_gse326622_per_gsm.sh.
caveats: CORRECTION vs v1.1.0: mechanotransduction here is a biological conclusion of the paper, NOT an applied mechanical-tension intervention. Do not describe this as a tension-loading experiment.
CORRECTION vs v1.1.0: timepoints are POD0/2/7/30, not Day 1/3/7/14.
n=1 sample per model per timepoint. There are no biological replicates, so the time axis carries no uncertainty estimate. Drift velocities calibrated against it are point estimates only.
Excisional, not incisional. It cannot stand in for a sutured surgical incision.
GSE326622.mapping_role: Murine temporal axis for T3. n=1 per model×timepoint; drift velocities are point estimates.

GSE241132.module: T3 human paired time course; T2 alternative-explanation check
GSE241132.verified: series_matrix + filelist read 2026-09-17; on disk as 12 per-GSM zips
GSE241132.title: Spatiotemporal Single-Cell Roadmap of Human Skin Wound Healing (Single-cell-Wound)
GSE241132.design: 3 healthy volunteers, each sampled at intact skin, wound day 1, day 7 and day 30 (paired within donor). Donors in GEO titles are Donor3/4/5; zip names are PWH26/27/28.
GSE241132.file_format: per-GSM CellRanger zip (features/barcodes/matrix). Series RAW.tar is 775,905,280 bytes; fetched per-GSM because series-level NCBI transfers are unreliable.
GSE241132.local_status: Downloaded to data/raw/GSE241132/ (745 MB): series_matrix, author cell_metadata, filelist, and 12/12 per_gsm zips.
caveats: Acute experimental wounds in healthy volunteers, not DFU. It tests whether a frozen DFU-trained encoder carries time, not whether topic 0 marks DFU healing.
n=3 donors. Leave-one-donor-out therefore trains on 2 contexts; out-of-sample failure is expected to be donor-count limited.
The attached cell metadata includes Patient, Age and Gender (PWH26 29/M, PWH27 22/F, PWH28 24/M), but no HbA1c, BMI or wound-duration variable suitable for the planned causal estimands.
Authors ship cell-type annotation and doublet calls; T3 uses those, not the in-house marker scorer.
GSE241132.mapping_role: Only human paired wound time axis in this repo. T3 held-out day-7 and leave-one-donor tests; T2 B-cell alternative-explanation check.

GSE223964.module: External DFU projection: human chronic diabetic and non-diabetic foot ulcers
GSE223964.title: Gene expression profile as single cell level of chronic diabetic foot ulcers and chronic non-diabetic foot ulcer
GSE223964.design: 5 diabetic and 3 non-diabetic chronic foot-ulcer samples; DIAC019/19B/19C are title-level replicate proxies
GSE223964.file_format: per-GSM 10x H5 matrices; author Integrated_all_cells.h5ad also downloaded for sample/age/sex/condition provenance

caveats: No healing or follow-up outcome is supplied; diabetic vs non-diabetic is not a healing endpoint.

GSE255786.title: Human transcriptomic response to periprosthetic joint infection
GSE255786.local_status: Downloaded to data/raw/GSE255786/ (23398 genes x 93 samples, 7 annotation columns + 93 count columns)
GSE255786.blocker: The PJI vs aseptic-failure grouping does not exist in any public metadata. The only characteristics keys are 'tissue: Knee/Hip' and 'cell type: Sonicate fluid'; SRA runinfo for PRJNA1076519 has an empty Disease column; there is no series-level label file and no linked PubMed ID. Without y there is no ROC, no AUC and no EMI discrimination curve.
GSE255786.secondary_risk: The source paper already performed PJI vs non-infection differential expression and reported 28 confirmed plus 3 novel biomarkers. Reproducing that discrimination is not a novel result.
GSE255786.note: The '.' characters that were previously reported as missing-value corruption are the GeneBiotype annotation column, not the count region. The counts are clean integers.
GSE255786.unblock_condition: Recover the per-specimen infection status from the publication's supplementary tables AND map it onto the internal specimen IDs (1005, 1006, 1013, ...) used as count-matrix column headers.

cohort_wide_constraint.statement: Series-level GEO characteristics across GSE165816, GSE231643, GSE241132, GSE223964, GSE245703, GSE80178 and GSE255786 provide tissue, disease, cell type, race, disease state, genotype, individual and treatment. The attached GSE241132 cell metadata additionally contains donor Patient, Age and Gender, and the GSE223964 author h5ad contains sample, Age, Sex and Condition; the cohort family still has no consistently linked HbA1c, BMI, wound duration, treatment assignment and follow-up outcome.
cohort_wide_constraint.implication: The available metadata do not identify a clinical causal estimand for Double Machine Learning / causal forest. A future causal design must specify its treatment, outcome, confounders and linkage at specimen level; it must not silently fabricate age, sex, BMI, HbA1c or wound duration. The retired DML stub under directions/_retired printed those confounder names without loading them; its mock_verification.py fabricates the covariates with np.random.normal.
